metaDesc: Cold press machine MH3248*30T, table size 400×160mm×2, cylinder count 2 PCS, for plywood and veneer pre-pressing. Factory direct from China.
description: cold press machine MH3248*30T from Shang Rui Machinery. table size 400×160mm×2, cylinder count 2 PCS, max pressure 30TBuilt for plywood and veneer production lines, this hydraulic cold press applies uniform pressure to glue-wiped veneer stacks before the hot press stage, improving board flatness and reducing rejects. Supplied by Shang Rui Machinery with CE certification on core models, technical support and lifetime spare parts availability.

faq.q: What is the maximum pressing pressure of the Cold Press MH3248*30T?
faq.a: The Cold Press MH3248*30T delivers up to 30T of pressing force, which covers standard plywood and veneer panel sizes.

faq.q: What size of board can this cold press handle?
faq.a: The working table measures 400×160mm×2, so standard plywood board sizes fit directly for pre-pressing glued veneer stacks.

faq.q: What power supply does this machine need?
faq.a: It runs on 380V/415V three-phase, the standard three-phase industrial supply used in most woodworking factories.

faq.q: Does Shang Rui supply spare parts and after-sales support?
faq.a: Yes. Spare parts are available for the life of the machine, and our engineers support installation, commissioning and operator training.
